claims.statement: If U is independent of a possibly dependent pair (V,Z), ||p_U||_infinity<=M_U, ||p_(V,Z)||_infinity<=M_2, then W=2aUV+H(V)+b(Z+theta(V))^2 has ||p_W||_infinity<=3*2^(2/3) M_U^(2/3) M_2^(2/3)|a|^(-2/3)|b|^(-1/3).

In the exact-rank-three heavy-isotropic normal form, every residual pair with Delta_jk=y_j z_k-y_k z_j nonzero yields ||p_Q||_infinity<=3*2^(2/3)c^(-1/3)|Delta_jk|^(-2/3)|det Lambda|^(-1/3)<6|Delta_jk|^(-2/3).
The exact residual identity sum_{j<k} Delta_jk^2=1 holds, but valid Parseval frames can have max|Delta_jk|<=2/m, so selecting one pair before applying the local bound can lose order m^(2/3).
Aggregate the full pair-Pluecker mass in a multi-pair coarea inequality before paying reciprocal local determinants, while preserving shared-coordinate dependence.
